ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across the visible central surface with approximately 85-90% white coverage; low-intensity (black) pixels are localized to the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blob occupying the central and lower visible surface. Solid black banding (5-15 pixel width) follows the entire trailing edge contour and expands into solid black regions at both the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a distinct, deep vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; irregular peak-to-valley pixel transitions with significant jaggedness visible against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed convex curve; the trailing edge maintains an upward convex trajectory from the central notch towards the sharp, slightly tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered, low-density dark circular pixel clusters (speckling) visible on the white ventral surface, primarily on the left lobe (viewer's left).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal dark linear marks visible on the white ventral surface of the left lobe (viewer's left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular indentation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe (viewer's left), appearing distinct from the regular serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and droplets creating high-intensity (white) point-source occlusions over the lower central surface of the fluke.
